description: Defines the QbonePacketProcessor class and related interfaces for processing IPv6 packets in the QBONE network, including packet filtering, forwarding, and ICMP handling.

classes.name: QbonePacketProcessor
classes.description: Handles IPv6 packet processing, filtering, and forwarding in the QBONE network.

classes.name: QbonePacketProcessor::OutputInterface
classes.description: Interface for sending packets to client or network.

classes.name: QbonePacketProcessor::StatsInterface
classes.description: Interface for recording packet processing statistics.

classes.name: QbonePacketProcessor::Filter
classes.description: Interface for custom packet filtering logic.

methods.name: QbonePacketProcessor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the packet processor with IP addresses, subnet, output, and stats interfaces.

methods.name: ProcessPacket
methods.description: Processes an IPv6 packet, deciding to forward, drop, or respond with ICMP.

methods.name: set_client_ip_subnet_length
methods.description: Updates the subnet length for the client IP.

methods.name: ProcessIPv6HeaderAndFilter
methods.description: Processes IPv6 header and applies filtering logic.

methods.name: SendIcmpResponse
methods.description: Sends an ICMP response to a specified destination.

methods.name: SendTcpReset
methods.description: Sends a TCP RST packet in response to a TCP packet.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the processor has a valid client IP address.

methods.name: GetDestinationFromPacket
methods.description: Extracts destination IP from a packet.
